recognition.summary: Apple publishes web-server security credits after reported issues have been identified and addressed.

reporting.summary: Apple directs vulnerability reports to its own Apple Security Research portal, using an Apple Account.

rewards.summary: Apple Security Bounty has separate eligibility rules. Appearance on the acknowledgment page does not establish a paid award.

limitations: The acknowledgment page concerns web-server reports; it is not a complete list of Apple security credits.
The authenticated submission flow was not opened or tested.

sources.title: Report a security or privacy vulnerability
